# Layout writing format

<!-- Generated by kition-sdk tools/writing-format.mjs from the Layout engine and agent/guide.md. Regenerate it; do not edit it by hand. -->

What a model or a script writes to make or change a Layout document: the run syntax, every
command and its parameters, the value lists and the defaults the engine states, and worked examples.
It is made from the command catalogue of the Layout engine. Read
[`agent/guide.md`](../agent/guide.md) first: it says how to address things, the workflow, and the
pitfalls.

## Syntax

Changes are steps of `layout_run`; each step is one command with its parameters as JSON:

```json
layout_run { "path": "<file>", "steps": [{ "command": "<command id>", "params": { … } }] }
```

A run is one step in the document's history. `layout_commands` finds commands by words; the
lists below are the whole catalogue. A parameter marked required must be given; a parameter left out
takes the engine's default (listed where the engine states one). Commands marked (reads) answer
without changing the document.

## Commands

458 commands, by menu.

### File > New

- `file.new` (writes): Replaces the open document with a new one from a page preset or size, with page count, facing pages, columns, gutter, margins and bleed.
  - `bleed` number, points
  - `columns` integer
  - `facingPages` boolean
  - `gutter` number, points
  - `height` number
  - `margins` number or object
  - `pages` integer[]
  - `preset` string, "Letter"|"A4"|…
  - `title` string
  - `width` number
- `book.new` (writes): Creates an empty book file (.dcbook) at a path.
  - `path` file
- `library.new` (writes): Creates an empty object library, saved to a path when given.
  - `path` file

### Help

- `file.newSample` (writes): Replaces the open document with a multi-page magazine sample, useful for trying commands. No parameters.

### (no menu)

- `file.presets` (reads): Lists the document presets (page sizes and settings) that file.new accepts. No parameters.
- `file.openBytes` (writes): Opens a document from base64 bytes (Kition Layout JSON or an IDML package) under a name.
  - `base64` string
  - `name` string
- `file.recovery.list` (reads): Lists unsaved documents a crash left in the recovery folder, with their paths and titles.
  - `dir` file
- `file.recovery.save` (writes): Writes every unsaved document to the recovery folder.
  - `dir` file
- `file.recovery.open` (writes): Reopens the documents left in the recovery folder, unsaved.
  - `dir` file
- `file.serialize` (reads): Answers the whole document as .klayout bytes in base64, without writing a file. No parameters.
- `file.activate` (writes): Makes the open document at an index the active one.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `place.styles` (reads): Reads a document's paragraph and character styles before importing them, listing the names and conflicts; changes nothing.
  - `name` string
- `snippet.place` (writes): Places a snippet's items on a spread, at their own positions unless x and y are given.
  - `spread` integer or object
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `place.load` (writes): Loads a graphic into the place cursor so place.drop puts it on the page.
  - `name` string
- `place.drop` (writes): Places the loaded graphic at a point, into a rectangle, or into a frame.
  - `frame` integer, an id
  - `rect` number[], [x0, y0, x1, y1]
  - `spread` integer or object
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `file.exportIdml` (reads): Writes the document as an IDML package to a path, or answers it as base64.
  - `embedImages` boolean, default `true`
  - `path` file
- `file.openIdml` (writes): Opens an IDML package (path or base64) as a new document.
  - `name` string
- `file.exportImage` (writes): Exports pages (default all) as PNG or JPEG images at a resolution, to a folder or as base64.
  - `background` string, one of `paper` | `transparent`, PNG only; default paper
  - `bleed` boolean
  - `format` string, one of `png` | `jpeg`, default png
  - `pages` string or array
  - `ppi` integer, default `72`, pixels per inch: 72 = one pixel per point
  - `quality` integer, 1 to 100; JPEG, default 90
  - `sizes` boolean, every size: the first page of the original and of each alternate layout, instead of `pages`
- `selection.set` (writes): Selects objects by id, adding to the selection or selecting their content when asked.
  - `add` boolean
  - `content` boolean
  - `ids` integer[]
- `selection.toggle` (writes): Adds an object to the selection, or removes it if it is selected.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `endnote.edit` (writes): Replaces an endnote's text, by its story and id.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
  - `text` string
- `endnote.delete` (writes): Deletes an endnote's reference and text, by its story and id.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `endnote.list` (reads): Lists the endnotes in numbering order with their story, id, number and text. No parameters.
- `note.edit` (writes): Changes a note's text or author.
  - `author` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
  - `text` string
- `note.list` (reads): Lists the notes in story order with their position, author and text. No parameters.
- `frame.create` (writes): Creates a frame on a spread from a rectangle [x0, y0, x1, y1] in spread coordinates, with a shape and content type (graphic, text, unassigned); answers its id.
  - `caret` boolean
  - `content` string, one of `graphic` | `text` | `unassigned`
  - `rect` number[], [x0, y0, x1, y1]; spread coords
  - `shape` string, one of `rectangle` | `ellipse` | `polygon`
  - `sides` integer, default `6`
  - `spread` integer or object
  - `text` string
  - `vertical` boolean, text: a new vertical story
- `line.create` (writes): Creates a straight line between two points on a spread; answers its id.
  - `a` number[]
  - `b` number[]
  - `spread` integer or object
- `transform.resize` (writes): Resizes objects from one rectangle to another, scaling content when asked.
  - `content` boolean, scale content
  - `distribute` boolean, Live Distribute: objects keep their size, their centres spread with the bounds
  - `from` number[], [x0, y0, x1, y1] in points
  - `ids` array
  - `to` number[], [x0, y0, x1, y1] in points
- `object.matchAttributes` (writes): Copies fill, stroke, corners, opacity, effects and wrap from one object to others, like the eyedropper.
  - `from` integer, an id
  - `ids` array
- `transform.set` (writes): Sets objects' position, size, scale, rotation and shear exactly, as the Transform panel does.
  - `height` number
  - `ids` array
  - `ref` integer, 0 to 8
  - `rotation` number, °
  - `scaleX` number, percent
  - `scaleY` number, percent
  - `shear` number, degrees
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `transform.info` (reads): Answers objects' scale, rotation and shear (and those of placed content).
  - `ids` array
- `object.setFlags` (writes): Sets objects' hidden and locked flags, as the Layers panel's eye and lock do.
  - `hidden` boolean
  - `ids` integer[]
  - `locked` boolean
- `object.fill` (writes): Sets objects' fill to a swatch with a tint from 0 to 1.
  - `ids` array
  - `swatch` string, a swatch name
  - `tint` integer, 0 to 1
- `object.stroke` (writes): Sets objects' stroke: swatch, tint, weight, alignment, stroke type, caps and joins, gap colour.
  - `align` string, one of `center` | `inside` | `outside`
  - `cap` string, one of `butt` | `round` | `projecting`
  - `end` string, one of `none` | `simple` | `simpleWide` | `triangle` | `triangleWide` | `barbed` | `curved` | `circle` | `circleSolid` | `square` | `squareSolid` | `bar`
  - `gapOverprint` boolean
  - `gapSwatch` string, a swatch name
  - `gapTint` number, percent
  - `ids` array
  - `join` string, one of `miter` | `round` | `bevel`
  - `miterLimit` number
  - `start` number
  - `swatch` string, a swatch name
  - `tint` number, percent from 0 to 100
  - `type` object, {kind:…}
  - `weight` number
- `object.opacity` (writes): Sets objects' opacity from 0 to 1 and blend mode.
  - `blend` string, normal|multiply|…
  - `ids` array
  - `opacity` integer, 0 to 1
- `object.rename` (writes): Renames an object by id.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `name` string
- `path.create` (writes): Creates a path from anchor points with optional handles, open or closed; answers its id.
  - `anchors` object[]
  - `closed` boolean
  - `spread` integer or object
- `path.appendAnchor` (writes): Adds an anchor point with handles at the end of a path.
  - `anchor` object, {p, in?, out?}
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `path.moveAnchors` (writes): Moves anchor points (or their handles) of a path by dx, dy.
  - `anchors` array[], [[subpath, index]]
  - `dx` number
  - `dy` number
  - `handle` string, one of `in` | `out`
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `tool.polygonSettings` (writes): Sets the number of sides and star inset new polygons use, and answers the settings.
  - `sides` number, 3–100
  - `starInset` number, 0–100 (%)
- `gap.move` (writes): Moves the gap between objects at a point (Gap tool), resizing the objects beside it.
  - `at` number[], spread
  - `spread` integer or object
- `frame.grid` (writes): Creates a grid of frames filling a rectangle with columns, rows and a gutter.
  - `cols` integer
  - `content` string, graphic, text or unassigned
  - `gutter` number, points
  - `rect` number[], [x0, y0, x1, y1] in points
  - `rows` integer
  - `shape` string, a frame shape such as rectangle or ellipse
  - `spread` integer or object
- `object.transparencyGroup` (writes): Sets isolate blending and knockout group on groups.
  - `ids` array
  - `isolate` boolean
  - `knockout` boolean
- `object.findByLabel` (reads): Answers the ids of objects whose script label equals a text.
  - `label` string
- `object.setLayer` (writes): Moves objects to a layer.
  - `ids` array
  - `layer` integer
- `frame.thread` (writes): Threads a text frame's story into another frame (or a new frame drawn on a spread).
  - `autoflow` boolean, Shift-click: then add pages with frames on their margins, threaded, until the story fits
  - `from` integer, an object id from document.inspect or object.list
  - `keepLoaded` boolean, load the text cursor again from the frame
  - `page` integer, 1-based: a new text frame on the page's margins
  - `rect` number[], [x0, y0, x1, y1]; a new text frame there, spread coords
  - `side` string, one of `out` | `in`, default out: the frame follows `from`; in: it goes before `from`
  - `spread` integer or object
  - `to` integer, an object id from document.inspect or object.list
- `frame.unthread` (writes): Breaks a text frame's thread after it (or before it); the following frames lose the story.
  - `frame` integer, an object id from document.inspect or object.list
  - `side` string, one of `out` | `in`, default out: break after the frame; in: before it
- `frame.loadText` (writes): Loads the text cursor from a text frame's out port (or in port) to continue its story elsewhere.
  - `frame` integer, an object id from document.inspect or object.list
  - `side` string, one of `out` | `in`, default out
- `page.background` (writes): Sets the page background colour (hex or swatch), or none for transparent.
  - `color` string or null
  - `pages` json[], [1-based] (default: every page); default: every page
- `template.list` (reads): Lists the starter layouts document.applyTemplate accepts, with their sizes. No parameters.
- `document.applyTemplate` (writes): Replaces the document's pages, parents and styles with a starter template (editorial, event, sale, quote).
  - `template` string, one of `editorial` | `event` | `sale` | `quote`
- `path.addAnchor` (writes): Adds an anchor point on a path at the nearest point to a position.
  - `at` number[], spread coords; the nearest point on the path
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `tolerance` number, points; default 4
- `path.deleteAnchor` (writes): Deletes an anchor point of a path by subpath and anchor index (0-based); the object goes when no path is left.
  - `anchor` integer
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `subpath` integer, a subpath counted from 0
- `path.convertAnchor` (writes): Converts an anchor point between corner and smooth, or drags out symmetric handles to a point.
  - `anchor` integer
  - `corner` boolean
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `subpath` integer, a subpath counted from 0
  - `to` number[], spread coords: drag out symmetric handles to there
- `path.erase` (writes): Erases the part of a path the drag points cross, as the Erase tool does.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `points` array[], spread coords: the Erase tool's drag
  - `tolerance` number, points; default 4
- `path.smooth` (writes): Smooths a path along the drag points, re-fitting fewer anchors.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `points` array[], spread coords
  - `tolerance` number, points; default 4
- `article.list` (reads): Lists the articles (export reading-order groups) with their items. No parameters.
- `article.add` (writes): Appends objects to an article in order.
  - `ids` array, default: the selection
  - `name` string
- `article.remove` (writes): Removes objects from an article.
  - `ids` array
  - `name` string
- `article.options` (writes): Renames an article, sets whether it exports, or reorders its items.
  - `export` boolean
  - `name` string
  - `order` json[], [ids] (reorder); reorder
  - `to` string, a new name
- `article.delete` (writes): Deletes an article; its objects stay.
  - `name` string
- `path.split` (writes): Cuts a path at the nearest point to a position (Scissors), opening it or splitting it in two.
  - `at` number[], spread coords; the nearest point on the path
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `book.open` (writes): Opens a book file and answers its documents.
  - `path` file
- `book.close` (writes): Closes the open book file. No parameters.
- `book.add` (writes): Adds a document to the book, optionally at an index.
  - `at` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `path` file
- `book.remove` (writes): Removes the document at an index from the book.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `book.styleSource` (writes): Makes the document at an index the book's style source.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `book.list` (reads): Answers the book: its path, style source and documents with their page counts and first pages. No parameters.
- `book.paginate` (writes): Renumbers the book's documents so each starts where the previous one ended. No parameters.
- `book.syncStyles` (writes): Copies the style source's paragraph and character styles and swatches into every document of the book. No parameters.
- `book.exportPdf` (writes): Exports every document of the book in order as one PDF.
  - `path` file
- `form.clear` (writes): Turns form fields back into ordinary objects.
  - `ids` array
- `form.list` (reads): Lists the form fields with their ids, kinds, names, values and options. No parameters.
- `button.list` (reads): Lists the buttons with their ids, names and actions. No parameters.
- `color.settings` (writes): Sets the working RGB and CMYK profiles and the rendering intent.
  - `bpc` boolean
  - `cmyk` string
  - `intent` string, one of `perceptual` | `relative` | `saturation` | `absolute`
  - `rgb` string
- `color.loadProfile` (writes): Loads an ICC profile from a path for use as a working space or proof target.
  - `path` file
- `color.convert` (reads): Converts a colour between RGB, CMYK and gray with the working profiles; changes nothing.
  - `color` object, {model: rgb, r, g, b} or {model: cmyk, c, m, y, k}
  - `to` string, one of `rgb` | `cmyk` | `gray` | `lab`
- `changes.list` (reads): Lists tracked changes with their story, position, kind (inserted or deleted) and text. No parameters.

  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `changes.reject` (writes): Rejects the tracked change at a story position.
  - `start` number
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `condition.list` (reads): Lists the conditional-text conditions with their colours and visibility. No parameters.
- `condition.options` (writes): Renames a condition or changes its colour or visibility.
  - `color` number[], [r, g, b]
  - `name` string
  - `to` string, a new name
  - `visible` boolean
- `condition.delete` (writes): Deletes a condition; the text it was applied to stays and shows.
  - `name` string
- `condition.apply` (writes): Applies a condition to the selected text, or removes it.
  - `name` string
  - `on` boolean, default true
  - `only` boolean, remove the others
- `library.open` (writes): Opens an object library from a path or JSON and answers its items. No parameters.
- `library.list` (reads): Lists the library's items with their indexes, names and descriptions. No parameters.
- `library.json` (reads): Answers the library as JSON text, to save where there is no file system. No parameters.
- `library.add` (writes): Adds the selection to the library as an item; answers its index.
  - `description` string
  - `name` string
- `library.place` (writes): Places a library item on a spread at its original position or at x, y.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `spread` integer or object
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `library.remove` (writes): Deletes a library item by index.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `conveyor.collect` (writes): Puts objects (default: the selection) onto the Content Collector conveyor.
  - `ids` array, default: the selection
- `conveyor.place` (writes): Places an item from the conveyor on a spread, keeping it on the conveyor when asked.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); 0
  - `keep` boolean, stay on the conveyor
  - `spread` integer or object
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `conveyor.list` (reads): Lists the items on the conveyor. No parameters.
- `conveyor.clear` (writes): Removes every item from the conveyor. No parameters.
- `library.close` (writes): Closes the open object library. No parameters.
- `list.delete` (writes): Deletes a named list.
  - `name` string
- `story.links` (reads): Lists linked stories with their parents and whether they are out of date. No parameters.
- `story.updateLink` (writes): Updates linked stories (default: every out-of-date one) from their parents.
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `story.unlink` (writes): Unlinks a story from its parent.
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `math.svg` (reads): Typesets a LaTeX expression and answers its SVG and size without placing it.
  - `latex` string, a LaTeX expression
  - `size` number
- `media.options` (writes): Sets placed media options: play on page load, loop, controls and poster.
  - `controls` boolean
  - `ids` array
  - `loop` boolean
  - `playOnPageLoad` boolean
  - `poster` object or null
- `media.get` (reads): Answers a media object's kind, name and playback options.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `object.pdfLayers` (reads): Lists the layers of the selected placed PDF with their visibility.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `liquid.object` (writes): Sets objects' liquid layout constraints: resize and pin to edges.
  - `ids` array
  - `pinBottom` boolean
  - `pinLeft` boolean
  - `pinRight` boolean
  - `pinTop` boolean
  - `resizeHeight` boolean
  - `resizeWidth` boolean
- `guide.liquid` (writes): Makes a guide a liquid guide, or not.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `on` boolean, default true
  - `page` integer
  - `spread` integer or object
- `layout.deleteAlternate` (writes): Deletes an alternate layout's pages and parents.
  - `name` string
- `layout.list` (reads): Lists the layouts with their first page, page count and size. No parameters.
- `xml.tags` (reads): Answers the XML tags, the style-to-tag map and whether a DTD is loaded. No parameters.
- `xml.deleteTag` (writes): Deletes an XML tag; tagged objects are untagged.
  - `name` string
- `xml.tagText` (writes): Tags the selected text as an inline element, or untags it.
  - `null` json, untag; one of several alternative parameters
  - `tag` string
- `xml.tag` (writes): Tags frames (default: the selection) with an XML tag, creating it if new, or untags them.
  - `ids` array, default: the selection
  - `tag` string
- `xml.mapStyle` (writes): Maps a paragraph style to an XML tag for export.
  - `style` string
- `xml.structure` (reads): Answers the XML structure in reading order: elements with tags, ids, kinds and text. No parameters.
- `xml.deleteDtd` (writes): Removes the loaded DTD. No parameters.
- `xml.validate` (reads): Validates the XML structure against the loaded DTD and answers the problems. No parameters.
- `strokeStyle.list` (reads): Lists the stroke styles with their kinds. No parameters.
- `strokeStyle.delete` (writes): Deletes a stroke style; strokes using it become solid.
  - `name` string
- `script.run` (writes): Runs a command script (lines of command ids with JSON parameters, or a JSON array) as one undo step.
  - `text` string
- `states.list` (reads): Lists a multi-state object's states and the active one.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `states.show` (writes): Shows one state of a multi-state object by index or name.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `states.rename` (writes): Renames a state of a multi-state object.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `name` string
- `states.release` (writes): Releases a multi-state object back to a plain group.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `page.transition` (writes): Sets a page transition (blinds, box, dissolve…) for pages, a spread, or all.
  - `duration` number, seconds; 1
  - `horizontal` boolean
  - `kind` string, one of `blinds` | `box` | `comb` | `cover` | `dissolve` | `fade` | `push` | `split` | `uncover` | `wipe` | `zoomIn` | `zoomOut` | `none`
  - `pages` integer[], pages counted from 1
- `page.transitions` (reads): Lists the page transitions by spread. No parameters.
- `type.onPath` (writes): Puts text on a path, with a start distance, flip and alignment.
  - `align` string, one of `baseline` | `ascender` | `descender` | `center`
  - `flip` boolean
  - `id` string
  - `start` number, distance along the path in points
  - `text` string
- `links.copyTo` (writes): Copies placed files to a folder and relinks the document to the copies.
  - `assets` json[], [asset ids] (default: all); default: all
  - `dir` file
- `file.printers` (reads): Lists the printers and the default one. No parameters.
- `text.placeCaret` (writes): Puts the text caret in a frame at a point, turning an empty frame into a text frame.
  - `frame` integer
  - `point` number[], spread coords
- `text.release` (writes): Ends a press in text at a point: a drag moves or copies the selected text there.
  - `copy` boolean
  - `frame` integer
  - `moved` boolean
  - `point` number[], [x, y] in points
- `text.extendTo` (writes): Extends the text selection to a point in a frame.
  - `frame` integer
  - `point` number[], [x, y] in points
- `text.selectWord` (writes): Selects the word at a point in a frame.
  - `frame` integer
  - `point` number[], [x, y] in points
- `text.select` (writes): Selects text in a story between two byte offsets, as find.find reports them.
  - `anchor` integer, a text position
  - `focus` integer, a text position
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `text.insert` (writes): Types text at the caret, replacing the selected text, with typographer's quotes unless raw.
  - `raw` boolean, no typographer's quotes
  - `text` string
- `text.delete` (writes): Deletes the selected text, or a character (or word) before or after the caret.
  - `forward` boolean
  - `word` boolean
- `text.move` (writes): Moves the text caret left, right, up, down, or to the line or story start or end, optionally by words or extending the selection.
  - `dir` string, one of `left` | `right` | `up` | `down` | `lineStart` | `lineEnd` | `storyStart` | `storyEnd`
  - `extend` boolean
  - `word` boolean
- `text.exitToFrame` (writes): Leaves text editing and selects the frame instead. No parameters.
- `story.setText` (writes): Replaces a story's whole text; the story is found by its id from document.inspect.
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
  - `text` string
- `story.replaceRange` (writes): Replaces a byte range of a story's text, keeping the surrounding formatting.
  - `end` number
  - `start` number
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
  - `text` string
- `story.get` (reads): Answers a story's text, frames, paragraphs, direction and whether it is overset; the way to read text. No parameters.
- `type.char` (writes): Sets character attributes on the selected text: font family and style, size, leading, tracking, colour and more.
  - `attrs` object, {fontFamily?, fontStyle?, size?, leading?: {kind:auto}|{kind:points,value}, tracking?, kerning?, hScale?, vScale?, baselineShift?, fill?, capitalization?, underline?, …}
- `type.para` (writes): Sets paragraph attributes on the selected paragraphs: alignment, indents, spacing, drop caps and more.
  - `attrs` object, {align?, leftIndent?, firstLineIndent?, spaceBefore?, spaceAfter?, dropCapLines?, hyphenate?, composer?, tabs?, ruleAbove?/ruleBelow?: {on?, weight?, color?, tint?, columnWidth?, offset?, leftIndent?, rightIndent?} (only the named rule fields change), …}; only the named rule fields change
- `type.align` (writes): Sets the alignment of the selected paragraphs by name.
  - `align` string, left|center|right|leftJustified|…
- `type.alignLeft` (writes): Aligns the selected paragraphs to the left. No parameters.
- `type.alignCenter` (writes): Centres the selected paragraphs. No parameters.
- `type.alignRight` (writes): Aligns the selected paragraphs to the right. No parameters.
- `type.justify` (writes): Justifies the selected paragraphs with the last line aligned left. No parameters.
- `type.bold` (writes): Toggles bold on the selected text. No parameters.
- `type.italic` (writes): Toggles italic on the selected text. No parameters.
- `type.underline` (writes): Toggles underline on the selected text. No parameters.
- `type.allCaps` (writes): Toggles all caps on the selected text. No parameters.
- `type.tateChuYoko` (writes): Sets the selected text horizontally within a vertical line (tate-chu-yoko), or not.
  - `on` boolean
- `type.ruby` (writes): Sets the ruby reading over the selected text; empty text removes it.

- `type.kenten` (writes): Turns emphasis dots (kenten) on the selected characters on or off.
  - `on` boolean
- `type.warichu` (writes): Turns warichu (inline split lines) on the selected text on or off, with lines, size, spacing and alignment.
  - `align` string, one of `auto` | `left` | `center` | `right` | `justify`
  - `charsAfterBreak` integer
  - `charsBeforeBreak` integer
  - `lineSpacing` number
  - `lines` integer
  - `on` boolean
  - `size` number
- `type.storyDirection` (writes): Makes the stories of the text selection or selected frames vertical or horizontal.
  - `vertical` boolean
- `type.sizeUp` (writes): Increases the selected text's point size by one step. No parameters.
- `type.sizeDown` (writes): Decreases the selected text's point size by one step. No parameters.

- `style.breakLink` (writes): Keeps the selected text's look as local formatting and detaches it from its paragraph or character style.

  - `name` string

  - `class` string
  - `style` string
  - `tag` string

  - `clearOverrides` boolean
  - `name` string
- `style.character.apply` (writes): Applies a character style to the selected text.

  - `fromSelection` boolean
  - `name` string
  - `nextStyle` string, a style name

- `style.paragraph.edit` (writes): Changes a paragraph style's name, base style, next style and attributes; text using it follows.
  - `basedOn` string, a style name
  - `chars` object
  - `name` string
  - `nextStyle` string, a style name
  - `para` object
  - `rename` string
- `style.paragraph.delete` (writes): Deletes a paragraph style, replacing it in text with another.
  - `name` string
  - `replaceWith` string, a style name
- `style.character.delete` (writes): Deletes a character style, replacing it in text with another (default [None]).
  - `name` string
  - `replaceWith` string, a style name
- `style.character.create` (writes): Creates a character style based on another, setting only the given attributes.
  - `basedOn` string, a style name
  - `chars` object
  - `name` string
- `style.character.edit` (writes): Changes a character style's name, base style and attributes; null removes an attribute.
  - `basedOn` string, a style name
  - `chars` object, {attr: value | null (no longer set)}; no longer set
  - `name` string
  - `rename` string

  - `name` string

  - `fromSelection` boolean, default `true`
  - `name` string
  - `paragraphStyle` string

  - `name` string
  - `spot` boolean

  - `from` number[]
  - `ids` array
  - `kind` string, one of `linear` | `radial`

  - `kind` string, one of `paragraph` | `character`
  - `names` json[], [style names]

  - `replace` boolean

  - `target` string, one of `fill` | `stroke`

  - `name` string, a new swatch name
  - `swatch` string, default: the selection's fill

  - `swatches` json[], [names]

- `swatch.renameColorGroup` (writes): Renames a colour group.
  - `name` string
  - `to` string, a new name
- `style.cell.create` (writes): Creates a table cell style with fill, tint, insets and paragraph style, or from the target cell.

  - `fromSelection` boolean, the target cell's look

  - `paragraphStyle` string

  - `vj` string, one of `top` | `center` | `bottom` | `justify`

  - `header` string, a cell style name
  - `leftColumn` string, a cell style name
  - `name` string
  - `rightColumn` string, a cell style name
  - `spaceAfter` number
  - `spaceBefore` number
- `style.table.apply` (writes): Applies a table style to a table.

  - `repeatFooter` boolean

  - `horizontalUnits` string, points, millimetres, inches…
  - `keyboardIncrement` number, points
  - `marginColor` string, a colour
  - `overprintBlack` boolean
  - `pasteboard` array, [h, v]
  - `slugColor` number[], [r, g, b]
  - `verticalUnits` string, points|picas|inches|millimeters|…
- `document.inspect` (reads): Answers the document's structure: pages, spreads, items with ids, stories with overset, styles, swatches and the selection. Use story.get for text. No parameters.
- `document.list` (reads): Lists the open documents with their indexes. No parameters.
- `tool.select` (writes): Selects an editor tool (selection, direct selection, type, frame…).
  - `tool` string, selection|directSelection|type|rectangleFrame|…
- `tool.list` (reads): Lists the editor tools. No parameters.
- `document.history` (reads): Answers the undo and redo history. No parameters.
- `find.objects` (writes): Finds and selects objects by fill, stroke, weight, opacity and kind; answers their ids.
  - `fill` string
  - `kind` string, one of `text` | `graphic` | `shape` | `line` | `group`
  - `label` string
  - `layer` integer
  - `opacity` number, 0–1
  - `select` boolean, default true
  - `stroke` string
  - `strokeWeight` number
- `find.changeObjects` (writes): Finds objects by criteria and changes their fill, stroke, weight or opacity; answers how many changed.
  - `change` object, {fill?, stroke?, strokeWeight?, opacity?}
- `variables.list` (reads): Lists the text variables with their types and values. No parameters.
- `variables.delete` (writes): Deletes a text variable; its instances become plain text.
  - `name` string
- `toc.entries` (reads): Answers the table-of-contents entries for styles (level, text, page) without changing the document. No parameters.
- `footnote.list` (reads): Lists footnotes in story order with their story, id, anchor and text.
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `footnote.setText` (writes): Replaces a footnote's text, by its story and id.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
  - `text` string
- `footnote.delete` (writes): Deletes a footnote's reference and text.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `xref.list` (reads): Lists the cross-references with their position, target, format and text. No parameters.
- `anchor.list` (reads): Lists the text anchors with their ids, names, stories, positions and pages. No parameters.
- `xref.formats` (reads): Lists the cross-reference formats with their definitions. No parameters.
- `xref.setFormat` (writes): Changes a cross-reference's format.
  - `format` string
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `index.list` (reads): Lists the index page references with their topics and pages. No parameters.
- `anchored.list` (reads): Lists anchored objects with their story, position and size.
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `guide.add` (writes): Adds a horizontal or vertical guide at a position on a spread or page.
  - `at` number, the other coordinate in points
  - `orientation` string, one of `horizontal` | `vertical`
  - `page` integer, index in the spread; default: the page under `at` or the position
  - `position` string
  - `spread` integer or object
  - `spreadGuide` boolean
- `guide.move` (writes): Moves a guide to a new position.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `page` integer
  - `position` string
  - `spread` integer or object
- `guide.delete` (writes): Deletes a guide by page and index.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `page` integer
  - `spread` integer or object
- `guide.list` (reads): Lists the guides on a spread with their orientation and position.
  - `spread` integer or object
- `links.list` (reads): Lists placed graphics' links with their status (ok, modified, missing, embedded), size and uses. No parameters.
- `font.families` (reads): Lists the font families text can be set in, or one family's styles.
  - `family` string
- `font.list` (reads): Lists the fonts used in the document with the characters set in them and whether any are missing. No parameters.
- `hyphenation.removeException` (writes): Removes a hyphenation exception.
  - `word` boolean
- `hyphenation.list` (reads): Lists the hyphenation exceptions. No parameters.
- `spelling.setWords` (writes): Replaces the document's user dictionary with a word list.
  - `words` json[], [word]
- `spelling.words` (reads): Lists the words in the document's user dictionary. No parameters.
- `spelling.change` (writes): Replaces a misspelled word at a story range.
  - `end` number
  - `start` number
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
  - `to` string, the replacement word
- `data.source.select` (writes): Selects a data merge source (CSV or spreadsheet by path or bytes) and answers its fields and records.
  - `delimiter` string, one of `comma` | `tab` | `semicolon`
  - `name` string
  - `sheet` string
- `data.source.update` (writes): Re-reads the linked data merge source. No parameters.
- `data.source.remove` (writes): Removes the data merge source; placeholders stay. No parameters.
- `data.fields` (reads): Answers data fields (name, kind, uses) from inline data or the linked source.
  - `name` string
- `data.placeholder.add` (writes): Inserts a data field placeholder (text, image, QR or hyperlink) in a story or on an item.
  - `at` number[], [x, y] in points
  - `end` number
  - `field` string
  - `item` integer
  - `role` string, one of `text` | `image` | `qr` | `hyperlink`
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `data.placeholder.remove` (writes): Removes a data field placeholder.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `data.options` (writes): Sets data merge options: records, layout per page, spacing, insets and image fitting.
  - `arrange` string
  - `center` boolean
  - `columnSpacing` number, points
  - `fitting` string
  - `insets` number or array
  - `limit` integer
  - `linkImages` boolean
  - `one` integer
  - `perPage` string
  - `range` string
  - `records` string
  - `rowSpacing` number, points
- `data.preview` (reads): Fills the template with one record for preview, for this session only.
  - `record` integer
- `data.preview.stop` (writes): Restores the unfilled template after a preview. No parameters.
- `data.merge` (writes): Creates a merged document from data and the template with the merge options.
  - `arrange` string
  - `center` boolean
  - `columnSpacing` number, points
  - `fitting` string
  - `insets` number or array
  - `limit` integer
  - `linkImages` boolean
  - `name` string
  - `one` integer
  - `perPage` string
  - `range` string
  - `records` string
  - `rowSpacing` number, points
- `hyperlink.delete` (writes): Deletes a hyperlink by id.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `hyperlink.list` (reads): Lists the hyperlinks with their ids, names and destinations. No parameters.
- `hyperlink.edit` (writes): Changes a hyperlink's name or destination.
  - `email` string
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `name` string
  - `page` integer, 1-based; one of several alternative parameters
  - `url` string, 1-based; one of several alternative parameters
- `hyperlink.goToSource` (writes): Selects a hyperlink's text or frame.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `bookmark.rename` (writes): Renames a PDF bookmark by index.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
  - `name` string
- `bookmark.add` (writes): Adds a PDF bookmark for a page (1-based).
  - `name` string
  - `page` integer, 1-based; default: current selection's page or 1
- `bookmark.delete` (writes): Deletes a PDF bookmark by index.
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `bookmark.list` (reads): Lists the PDF bookmarks. No parameters.

### File

- `file.open` (writes): Opens a .klayout or .idml file from a path; fonts in a Document Fonts folder beside it load too.
  - `path` file
- `file.save` (writes): Saves the document to its path, or to the given path, as .klayout.
  - `path` file
- `file.saveAs` (writes): Saves the document under a new path, which becomes its path.
  - `path` file
- `file.saveACopy` (writes): Writes a copy of the document to a path without changing which file it is or its unsaved state.
  - `path` file
- `file.revert` (writes): Throws away unsaved changes and reloads the last saved version; this cannot be undone. No parameters.
- `file.close` (writes): Closes the open document (or the one at an index).
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0)
- `file.place` (writes): Places a graphic or text file (by path or base64) on a spread or into a frame, at a position and size, with the page of a PDF.
  - `frame` integer, an id; place into
  - `layoutPage` integer, IDML / .klayout: that page's objects as a group
  - `name` string
  - `pdfCrop` string, one of `crop` | `trim` | `bleed` | `art` | `media`
  - `pdfPage` integer, 1-based, Image Import Options
  - `spread` integer or object
  - `width` number
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `file.exportPdf` (writes): Exports pages (default all) to PDF with a preset, marks and bleed, to a path or as base64.
  - `advanceSeconds` number, interactive PDF
  - `author` string
  - `bleed` boolean, document bleed
  - `bookmarksPanel` boolean
  - `compressImages` boolean
  - `flatten` string, one of `high` | `medium` | `low` | `ppi`, Transparency Flattener: spreads with transparency are rasterised
  - `fullScreen` boolean
  - `marks` boolean or object
  - `media` boolean, interactive: embed placed video and sound
  - `pageLayout` string, one of `single` | `continuous` | `twoUp` | `twoUpCover` | `twoUpContinuous`
  - `pages` string or array
  - `path` file
  - `spreads` boolean
  - `standard` string, one of `none` | `x4` | `a2b`
  - `tagged` boolean, structure tree: stories as paragraphs, figures with alt text
  - `title` string
  - `view` string, one of `fitPage` | `fitWidth` | `actual`
- `file.exportEpub` (writes): Exports a reflowable EPUB with title, author, language and cover, to a path or as base64.
  - `author` string
  - `cover` boolean, the first page as the cover image
  - `fixedLayout` boolean, pre-paginated: each page as an image with its text
  - `language` string, like en
  - `path` file
  - `title` string
- `file.exportFixedEpub` (writes): Exports a fixed-layout (pre-paginated) EPUB, to a path or as base64.
  - `author` string
  - `language` string
  - `path` file
  - `title` string
- `file.printBooklet` (writes): Exports printer spreads for a booklet (saddle stitch or two-up) as PDF.
  - `path` file
  - `spaceBetween` number, points
  - `type` string, one of `saddleStitch` | `twoUpConsecutive`
- `file.exportHtml` (writes): Exports one self-contained HTML page with inline styles and embedded images.
  - `language` string
  - `path` file
  - `title` string
- `file.exportText` (writes): Exports a story's text as plain text, RTF or Tagged Text.
  - `format` string, one of `txt` | `rtf` | `tagged`, Tagged Text; default from the path, else txt
  - `frame` integer
  - `path` file
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `file.exportXml` (writes): Exports the tagged content as XML, to a path or as text.
  - `path` file
- `file.importXml` (writes): Imports XML, putting each element's content into the next frame with that tag. No parameters.
- `file.package` (writes): Packages the document into a new folder with its fonts, links, and optionally IDML, PDF and instructions.
  - `dir` file, folder to create
  - `idml` boolean, default `true`
  - `instructions` string
  - `pdf` boolean, default `false`
- `file.print` (writes): Prints pages or spreads to a printer with copies, marks and bleed; dryRun only answers what would print.
  - `bleed` number, points
  - `copies` integer, default `1`
  - `dryRun` boolean, only return the spool command
  - `marks` boolean or object
  - `pages` string, like 1-3,5
  - `printer` string
  - `spreads` boolean
- `layout.documentSetup` (writes): Sets the document's page size, page count, start page, facing pages, binding, bleed and slug.
  - `adjustLayout` boolean, objects follow the new page size
  - `binding` string, one of `leftToRight` | `rightToLeft`
  - `bleed` number, points
  - `facingPages` boolean
  - `height` number
  - `intent` string, one of `print` | `web` | `mobile`
  - `pages` integer
  - `slug` number or array
  - `startPage` integer
  - `width` number

### File > Export

- `snippet.export` (reads): Exports the selected items with their stories, styles and images as a .klayout snippet, to a path or as base64.
  - `path` file

### Edit

- `edit.undo` (writes): Undoes the last step of the caller's own scope (an agent undoes its own edits, not the person's).
  - `scope` string, one of `person` | `agent`
- `edit.redo` (writes): Redoes the last undone step of the caller's own scope.
  - `scope` string, one of `person` | `agent`
- `edit.selectAll` (writes): Selects all items on the active spreads, or all text when editing a story. No parameters.
- `edit.deselectAll` (writes): Clears the selection; no object stays selected. No parameters.
- `edit.clear` (writes): Deletes the selected items (or the given ids), or the selected text.
  - `ids` array
- `edit.copy` (writes): Copies the selection; for selected text it answers the text with its formatting. No parameters.
- `edit.cut` (writes): Cuts the selection to the clipboard. No parameters.
- `edit.pasteWithoutFormatting` (writes): Pastes plain text at the insertion point in the formatting there.
  - `text` string
- `edit.paste` (writes): Pastes the clipboard (or given text), optionally in place at the copied position.
  - `inPlace` boolean
  - `text` string, text to paste instead of the clipboard
- `edit.pasteInto` (writes): Pastes the copied objects into the selected frame as its content, clipped by it.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `edit.pasteInPlace` (writes): Pastes the copied objects at their original positions. No parameters.
- `edit.duplicate` (writes): Duplicates the selected objects, offset from the originals. No parameters.
- `edit.stepAndRepeat` (writes): Makes copies of the selection a number of times at a dx, dy offset, or as a grid of rows and columns.
  - `columns` integer
  - `count` integer, 1 to 1000
  - `dx` number
  - `dy` number
  - `ids` array
  - `rows` integer
- `story.placeAndLink` (writes): Places a linked copy of a story in a new frame; the copy follows the parent when updated.
  - `rect` number[], [x0, y0, x1, y1] in points
  - `spread` integer or object
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `find.next` (writes): Selects the next match of a text after the caret.
  - `find` string
  - `grep` boolean

### Type

- `endnote.insert` (writes): Inserts an endnote reference at the insertion point with its text; the first one creates the endnote frame.
  - `text` string
- `endnote.options` (writes): Sets endnote numbering style, start, prefix and suffix, heading and styles.
  - `heading` string
  - `headingStyle` string, a paragraph style name
  - `paraStyle` string, a paragraph style name
  - `prefix` string
  - `separator` string
  - `startAt` integer
  - `style` string, one of `arabic` | `upperRoman` | `lowerRoman` | `upperLetters` | `lowerLetters`
  - `suffix` string
- `type.createOutlines` (writes): Converts text frames into compound paths of their glyphs.
  - `ids` array
- `math.insert` (writes): Inserts a math expression typeset from LaTeX at the text insertion point or at a position.
  - `latex` string, a LaTeX expression
  - `size` number
  - `spread` integer or object
  - `x` number
  - `y` number
- `type.fillWithPlaceholder` (writes): Fills a text frame with placeholder text.
  - `frame` integer
- `type.changeCase` (writes): Changes the selected text (or selected frames' stories) to upper, lower, title or sentence case.
  - `case` string, one of `upper` | `lower` | `title` | `sentence`
- `footnote.insert` (writes): Inserts a footnote reference at the insertion point with its text; the caret moves into the footnote.
  - `text` string
- `footnote.options` (writes): Sets footnote numbering, styles, spacing and layout options.
  - `affixIn` string, one of `none` | `reference` | `text` | `both`
  - `firstBaseline` string
  - `firstBaselineMin` number, points
  - `paraStyle` string, a paragraph style name
  - `prefix` string
  - `refCharStyle` string, a character style name
  - `refPosition` string, one of `superscript` | `subscript` | `normal` | `otSuperscript`
  - `restart` string, one of `never` | `page` | `spread` | `section`
  - `rule` object, {on, weight, color, tint, width, offset, leftIndent}
  - `separator` string
  - `spaceBefore` number
  - `spaceBetween` number, points
  - `spanColumns` boolean
  - `startAt` integer
  - `style` string, one of `arabic` | `upperRoman` | `lowerRoman` | `upperLetters` | `lowerLetters` | `symbols`
  - `suffix` string
- `footnote.goToReference` (writes): Moves the caret from footnote text to just after its reference. No parameters.
- `font.replace` (writes): Replaces a font family and style in text (and styles, unless told not to) with another.
  - `family` string
  - `redefineStyles` boolean, default `true`
  - `style` string
  - `toFamily` string
  - `toStyle` string

### Type > Notes

- `note.new` (writes): Adds an editorial note (not printed) with text and author at the insertion point; answers its story and id.
  - `author` string
  - `text` string
- `note.delete` (writes): Deletes an editorial note by its story and id.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `note.convertToText` (writes): Turns a note into ordinary story text in place of its anchor.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect

### Object > Transform

- `transform.move` (writes): Moves objects (default: the selection) by dx and dy points, optionally as a copy or to another spread.
  - `copy` boolean
  - `dx` number
  - `dy` number
  - `ids` array
  - `toSpread` integer or object
- `transform.rotate` (writes): Rotates objects by an angle in degrees, counter-clockwise, about their centre.
  - `angle` number, degrees, CCW
  - `ids` array
- `transform.scale` (writes): Scales objects by sx and sy about the selection centre.
  - `ids` array
  - `sx` number, horizontal scale factor
  - `sy` number, vertical scale factor
- `transform.clear` (writes): Removes rotation, shear and scaling from objects, keeping their centre.
  - `ids` array
- `transform.shear` (writes): Shears objects by an angle in degrees.
  - `angle` number, degrees
  - `ids` array
- `transform.flip` (writes): Flips objects horizontally or vertically.
  - `axis` string, one of `horizontal` | `vertical`
  - `ids` array

### Object > Transform Again

- `transform.again` (writes): Repeats the last transform (or sequence of transforms) on the selection.
  - `ids` array
  - `individually` boolean
  - `sequence` boolean

### Object > Arrange

- `object.arrange` (writes): Moves objects to the front, forward, backward or to the back of the stacking order.
  - `ids` array
  - `to` string, one of `front` | `forward` | `backward` | `back`
- `object.bringToFront` (writes): Brings the selection to the front. No parameters.
- `object.bringForward` (writes): Brings the selection one step forward. No parameters.
- `object.sendBackward` (writes): Sends the selection one step backward. No parameters.
- `object.sendToBack` (writes): Sends the selection to the back. No parameters.

### Object

- `object.group` (writes): Groups objects (default: the selection) into one group.
  - `ids` array
- `object.ungroup` (writes): Splits groups back into their objects.
  - `ids` array
- `object.lock` (writes): Locks objects so they cannot be selected or changed on the canvas.
  - `ids` array
- `object.unlockAll` (writes): Unlocks every locked object on the spread. No parameters.
- `object.hide` (writes): Hides objects; they stay in the document.
  - `ids` array
- `object.showAll` (writes): Shows every hidden object on the spread. No parameters.
- `object.exportOptions` (writes): Sets objects' export options: tagged-PDF artifact, rasterising for EPUB and HTML, alignment.
  - `align` string, one of `left` | `center` | `right` | ``
  - `altText` string
  - `artifact` boolean, tagged PDF decoration
  - `ids` array
  - `pageBreakBefore` boolean
  - `rasterize` boolean, EPUB/HTML image
- `object.textFrameOptions` (writes): Sets text frames' columns, gutter, insets, vertical justification, first baseline, auto-size and column rules.
  - `autoSize` boolean
  - `balanceColumns` boolean
  - `columnRule` boolean
  - `columnRuleBottomInset` number, points
  - `columnRuleColor` string, #rrggbb or a swatch name
  - `columnRuleOffset` number, points
  - `columnRuleTint` number, 0..1
  - `columnRuleTopInset` number, points
  - `columnRuleWeight` number, points
  - `columns` integer
  - `firstBaseline` string
  - `gutter` number, points
  - `ids` array
  - `ignoreWrap` boolean
  - `inset` number or array
  - `vertical` boolean, sets the story direction of the frames' stories, as Type ▸ Story Direction
  - `verticalJustification` string, one of `top` | `center` | `bottom` | `justify`
- `object.cornerOptions` (writes): Sets objects' corner shape (rounded, inverse rounded, inset, bevel, fancy) and size.
  - `ids` array
  - `shape` string, one of `none` | `rounded` | `inverseRounded` | `inset` | `bevel` | `fancy`
  - `size` number
- `object.primaryTextFrame` (writes): Makes the selected text frame's story the primary text frame, or turns that off.
  - `ids` array
  - `on` boolean, default: toggle
- `object.altText` (writes): Sets the alternative text of objects for tagged PDF and EPUB.
  - `ids` array
  - `text` string
- `object.layerOptions` (writes): Hides layers of placed PDFs by name.
  - `hidden` json[], [layer name]
  - `ids` array
- `object.qrCode` (writes): Generates a QR code object for a URL, text, SMS, email or vCard.
  - `body` string
  - `color` string, swatch, [Black]
  - `content` string, the URL or text
  - `email` string
  - `message` string
  - `name` string
  - `number` string
  - `org` string
  - `phone` string
  - `rect` number[], [x0, y0, x1, y1] in points
  - `spread` integer or object
  - `subject` string
  - `to` string, the recipient
  - `type` string
  - `url` string

### Object > Effects

- `object.dropShadow` (writes): Turns a drop shadow on or off and sets its distance, angle, opacity, size, spread and colour.
  - `angle` number
  - `color` string, swatch
  - `distance` number, points
  - `globalLight` boolean
  - `ids` array
  - `on` boolean
  - `opacity` number
  - `size` number
  - `spread` integer or object
- `object.innerShadow` (writes): Turns an inner shadow on or off and sets its distance, angle, opacity, size, choke and colour.
  - `angle` number
  - `choke` number, percent
  - `color` string
  - `distance` number, points
  - `globalLight` boolean
  - `ids` array
  - `on` boolean
  - `opacity` number
  - `size` number
- `object.outerGlow` (writes): Turns an outer glow on or off and sets its opacity, size, spread and colour.
  - `color` string
  - `ids` array
  - `on` boolean
  - `opacity` number
  - `size` number
  - `spread` integer or object
- `object.innerGlow` (writes): Turns an inner glow on or off and sets its opacity, size, choke, source and colour.
  - `center` boolean, glow from the centre
  - `choke` number, percent
  - `color` string
  - `ids` array
  - `on` boolean
  - `opacity` number
  - `size` number
- `object.bevel` (writes): Turns bevel and emboss on or off with size, depth, angle, highlight and shadow.
  - `angle` number
  - `depth` number, percent
  - `globalLight` boolean
  - `highlight` string, a colour or swatch name
  - `highlightOpacity` number, percent
  - `ids` array
  - `on` boolean
  - `shadow` string, a colour or swatch name
  - `shadowOpacity` number, percent
  - `size` number
- `object.satin` (writes): Turns a satin effect on or off with opacity, angle, distance, size and colour.
  - `angle` number
  - `color` string
  - `distance` number, points
  - `ids` array
  - `invert` boolean
  - `on` boolean
  - `opacity` number
  - `size` number
- `object.directionalFeather` (writes): Turns a directional feather on or off with widths per side.
  - `ids` array
  - `on` boolean
  - `widths` number or array
- `object.feather` (writes): Sets a basic feather width on objects (0 turns it off).
  - `ids` array
  - `width` number, 0 = off
- `object.globalLight` (writes): Sets the light angle shared by effects that use global light.
  - `angle` number
- `object.gradientFeather` (writes): Turns a gradient feather on or off, linear or radial, with angle and start and end opacity.
  - `angle` number
  - `end` number, 0
  - `from` number[]
  - `ids` array
  - `on` boolean, default `true`
  - `radial` boolean
  - `start` number, opacity from 0 to 100
  - `to` number[], spread coords: the Gradient Feather tool's drag

### Object > Content

- `object.content` (writes): Sets what a frame holds: graphic, text or unassigned.
  - `ids` array
  - `type` string, one of `graphic` | `text` | `unassigned`

### Window

- `object.textWrap` (writes): Sets how text wraps around objects (bounding box, contour, jump object, jump to next column) and the offset.
  - `ids` array
  - `invert` boolean
  - `mode` string, one of `none` | `boundingBox` | `contour` | `jumpObject` | `jumpToNextColumn`
  - `offset` number or array

### Object > Fitting

- `object.fit` (writes): Fits a frame's graphic: fill or fit proportionally, fit content to frame, centre, or frame to content.
  - `ids` array
  - `mode` string, one of `fillProportionally` | `fitProportionally` | `fitContentToFrame` | `centerContent` | `fitFrameToContent`
- `object.fittingOptions` (writes): Sets a frame's fitting options: auto-fit, fitting, alignment reference and crop amounts.
  - `align` integer, 0 to 8; reference point, 4 = centre
  - `autoFit` boolean
  - `crop` number or array
  - `fitting` string, one of `none` | `fillProportionally` | `fitProportionally` | `fitContentToFrame` | `centerContent`
  - `ids` array
- `frame.fitText` (writes): Shrinks the text of text frames until it fits without overset, down to a minimum size.
  - `ids` integer[], object ids; default: the selection
  - `max` number, points; default 1296
  - `min` number, points; default 1

### Object > Paths

- `path.close` (writes): Closes an open path.
  - `id` integer or string, an id
- `object.makeCompoundPath` (writes): Joins the selected paths into one compound path with the backmost object's look.
  - `ids` array
- `object.releaseCompoundPath` (writes): Splits a compound path so each subpath becomes its own object; answers their ids.
  - `ids` array

### Window > Object & Layout > Align

- `object.align` (writes): Aligns objects' edges or centres to each other, the key object, the margins, the page or the spread.
  - `edge` string, one of `left` | `hcenter` | `right` | `top` | `vcenter` | `bottom`
  - `ids` array
  - `to` string, one of `selection` | `keyObject` | `margins` | `page` | `spread`
- `object.distribute` (writes): Distributes objects horizontally or vertically by centres or by equal spacing.
  - `axis` string, one of `horizontal` | `vertical`
  - `by` string, one of `centers` | `spacing`
  - `ids` array
  - `spacing` number, points

### Object > Clipping Path

- `object.clippingPath` (writes): Makes a clipping path for a placed graphic from its alpha channel or detected edges, with a threshold.
  - `ids` array
  - `threshold` number
  - `tolerance` number, pixels; 2
  - `type` string, one of `alpha` | `edges`, default alpha

### Window > Output > Attributes

- `object.attributes` (writes): Sets objects' print attributes: overprint fill, stroke and gap, and non-printing.
  - `ids` array
  - `nonprinting` boolean
  - `overprintFill` boolean
  - `overprintGap` boolean
  - `overprintStroke` boolean

### Window > Utilities > Script Label

- `object.label` (writes): Sets a free-text script label on objects so scripts and agents can find them with object.findByLabel.
  - `ids` array
  - `label` string

### View > Extras

- `view.showTextThreads` (writes): Shows or hides the lines between threaded text frames in the editor.
  - `on` boolean, default: toggle

### Window > Articles

- `article.new` (writes): Creates an article from objects (default: the selection); answers its name.
  - `ids` array, default: the selection
  - `name` string

### Object > Pathfinder

- `object.pathfinder` (writes): Combines the selected shapes by add, subtract, intersect, exclude or minus back.
  - `ids` array
  - `op` string, one of `add` | `subtract` | `intersect` | `exclude` | `minusBack`

### Object > Interactive

- `button.set` (writes): Turns objects into buttons that go to a page, the first, last, next or previous page, or a URL.
  - `action` string, one of `page` | `firstPage` | `lastPage` | `nextPage` | `previousPage` | `url` | `none`
  - `ids` array
  - `page` integer
  - `url` string
- `button.clear` (writes): Turns buttons back into ordinary objects.
  - `ids` array
- `form.set` (writes): Turns objects into form fields (text field, check box, combo box, list box, signature) with name, value and options.
  - `fontSize` number, points
  - `ids` array
  - `kind` string, one of `textField` | `checkBox` | `comboBox` | `listBox` | `signature`
  - `multiline` boolean
  - `name` string
  - `options` string[]
  - `required` boolean
  - `value` string

### Object > Captions

- `object.caption` (writes): Generates a static caption below objects from a template with variables such as {name} and {altText}.
  - `height` number, pt, 24
  - `ids` array
  - `live` boolean, kept current as the source changes
  - `offset` number, pt, 0
  - `position` string, one of `below` | `above` | `left` | `right`
  - `style` string
  - `text` string, a caption template such as {name}

### Type > Track Changes

- `changes.track` (writes): Turns Track Changes in stories on or off; without on it toggles.
  - `on` boolean, default: toggle
- `changes.acceptAll` (writes): Accepts every tracked change (in one story or all).
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
- `changes.rejectAll` (writes): Rejects every tracked change (in one story or all).
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect

### Window > Type & Tables > Conditional Text

- `condition.new` (writes): Creates a condition with a colour and visibility; answers its name.
  - `color` number[], [r, g, b]
  - `name` string
  - `visible` boolean

### Type > Bulleted and Numbered Lists

- `list.define` (writes): Defines or renames a named list that numbered paragraphs can join across stories.
  - `continueAcrossStories` boolean, default `true`
  - `name` string
  - `rename` string

### Layout > Liquid Layout

- `liquid.pageRule` (writes): Sets the liquid layout rule (scale, re-centre, guide or object based) for pages.
  - `pages` json[], [1-based] (default: all); default: all
  - `rule` string, one of `off` | `scale` | `reCenter` | `guideBased` | `objectBased`

### Layout

- `layout.createAlternate` (writes): Creates an alternate layout of the pages at a new size, with a page rule.
  - `height` number
  - `name` string
  - `rule` string, a page rule such as scale or reCenter
  - `source` string, a layout name
  - `width` number
- `layout.marginsAndColumns` (writes): Sets pages' margins and columns.
  - `adjustLayout` boolean, objects follow the margins
  - `columns` integer
  - `gutter` number, points
  - `margins` number or object
  - `pages` integer[], default all
- `layout.section` (writes): Starts a section at a page (1-based) with a start number, numbering style and marker.
  - `includePrefix` boolean
  - `marker` string
  - `page` integer, 1-based; starts a section there
  - `prefix` string
  - `remove` boolean
  - `startNumber` integer or null
  - `style` string, one of `arabic` | `upperRoman` | `lowerRoman` | `upperLetters` | `lowerLetters`
- `toc.generate` (writes): Generates a table of contents from paragraph styles with levels, a title and page numbers, in a new frame.
  - `entries` object[]
  - `page` integer, a page counted from 1
  - `pageNumbers` boolean, default `true`
  - `rect` number[], [x0, y0, x1, y1]; spread coords
  - `title` string, like Contents
- `toc.update` (writes): Regenerates the existing table of contents. No parameters.
- `layout.createGuides` (writes): Creates rows and columns of guides with gutters, fitted to the margins or the page.
  - `columnGutter` integer, default `12`
  - `columns` integer, 0 to 1000
  - `fitTo` string, one of `margins` | `page`
  - `page` integer, index in the spread; default all pages
  - `removeExisting` boolean, default `false`
  - `rowGutter` integer, default `12`
  - `rows` integer, 0 to 1000
  - `spread` integer or object

### Window > Utilities > Tags

- `xml.newTag` (writes): Creates an XML tag with a colour.
  - `color` number[], [r, g, b]
  - `name` string
- `xml.loadDtd` (writes): Loads a DTD for validation and adds a tag for each element it declares. No parameters.

### Object > Stroke Styles

- `strokeStyle.new` (writes): Creates a stroke style of stripes, dashes or dots.
  - `bands` array[], fractions of the weight
  - `name` string
  - `pattern` number[], [dash, gap]; pt
  - `type` string, one of `stripes` | `dash` | `dot`

### Window > Interactive > Object States

- `states.create` (writes): Turns objects (or one group's objects) into a multi-state object.
  - `ids` array, default: the selection; one group's objects or several objects become states

### Type > Type on a Path

- `type.pathOptions` (writes): Changes type on a path's start, flip and alignment, or removes it.
  - `align` string, one of `baseline` | `ascender` | `descender` | `center`
  - `delete` boolean, default `true`, Delete Type from Path
  - `flip` boolean
  - `id` integer or string, an id
  - `start` number

### Object > Select

- `select.firstAbove` (writes): Selects the frontmost object on the spread. No parameters.
- `select.nextAbove` (writes): Selects the next object above the selection in the stacking order. No parameters.
- `select.nextBelow` (writes): Selects the next object below the selection in the stacking order. No parameters.
- `select.lastBelow` (writes): Selects the backmost object on the spread. No parameters.
- `select.container` (writes): Selects the group or frame that holds the selection. No parameters.
- `select.content` (writes): Selects the graphic inside a frame, or the first object in a group. No parameters.
- `select.nextInGroup` (writes): Selects the next object in the selection's group. No parameters.
- `select.previousInGroup` (writes): Selects the previous object in the selection's group. No parameters.

### Object > Convert Shape

- `object.convertShape` (writes): Converts objects to another shape (rectangle, rounded rectangle, ellipse, triangle, polygon, line…).
  - `ids` array
  - `to` string, one of `rectangle` | `roundedRectangle` | `beveledRectangle` | `inverseRoundedRectangle` | `ellipse` | `triangle` | `polygon` | `line` | `orthogonalLine` | `openPath` | `closedPath`

### Type > Story Column Direction

- `story.setDirection` (writes): Sets a story's column progression to left to right or right to left.
  - `direction` string, one of `leftToRight` | `rightToLeft`
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect

### Table

- `table.convertFromText` (writes): Converts the selected paragraphs into a table, splitting columns at tabs or commas.
  - `columnSeparator` string, one of `tab` | `comma`
- `table.convertToText` (writes): Converts the table at the caret into tab-separated paragraphs. No parameters.
- `table.merge` (writes): Merges the target cell range into one cell. No parameters.
- `table.sortRows` (writes): Sorts the body rows by a column (0-based; default the target cell's), ascending or descending.
  - `column` integer
  - `descending` boolean
- `table.unmerge` (writes): Unmerges the target merged cell. No parameters.
- `table.splitHorizontally` (writes): Splits the target cell into two, one above the other. No parameters.
- `table.splitVertically` (writes): Splits the target cell into two, side by side. No parameters.
- `table.distributeColumns` (writes): Gives the selected columns equal widths. No parameters.
- `table.distributeRows` (writes): Gives rows equal fixed heights.
  - `rows` number[], [a, b]
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
  - `table` integer

### Table > Insert

- `table.insertRowAbove` (writes): Inserts rows above the target cell's row.
  - `count` integer
- `table.insertRowBelow` (writes): Inserts rows below the target cell's row.
  - `count` integer
- `table.insertColumnLeft` (writes): Inserts columns to the left of the target cell's column.
  - `count` integer
- `table.insertColumnRight` (writes): Inserts columns to the right of the target cell's column.
  - `count` integer

### Table > Delete

- `table.deleteRow` (writes): Deletes the rows of the target cells. No parameters.
- `table.deleteColumn` (writes): Deletes the columns of the target cells. No parameters.
- `table.delete` (writes): Deletes the table at the caret. No parameters.

### Table > Convert Cell Type

- `table.placeGraphic` (writes): Turns the target cell into a graphic cell holding an image, fitted proportionally or to fill.
  - `fit` string, one of `proportional` | `fill`, default proportional
- `table.textCell` (writes): Turns graphic cells back into text cells. No parameters.

### Table > Select

- `table.selectTable` (writes): Selects the whole table at the caret. No parameters.
- `table.selectRow` (writes): Selects the row at the caret. No parameters.
- `table.selectColumn` (writes): Selects the column at the caret. No parameters.

### Layout > Pages

- `layout.pages.insert` (writes): Inserts pages after a page (default: the last) with a parent.
  - `after` integer, a page counted from 0; default: the last
  - `count` integer, default `1`
  - `parent` string, one of `A` | `null`
- `layout.pages.delete` (writes): Deletes pages by index.
  - `pages` integer[]
- `layout.pages.move` (writes): Moves a page from one index to another.
  - `from` integer, a page counted from 0
  - `to` integer, a page counted from 0
- `layout.pages.duplicateSpread` (writes): Duplicates a spread with its items.
  - `spread` integer or object
- `layout.pages.applyParent` (writes): Applies a parent spread to pages, or none.
  - `pages` integer[]
  - `parent` string, one of `A` | `null`
- `layout.parents.new` (writes): Creates a parent spread with a prefix and name.
  - `name` string, like Parent
  - `prefix` string
- `layout.pages.toSpread` (writes): Adds a page (1-based) to a spread (0-based).
  - `page` integer, 1-based
  - `spread` integer or object
- `layout.spreadShuffle` (writes): Allows or stops a spread's pages shuffling apart when pages are added or removed.
  - `allow` boolean
  - `spread` integer or object
- `layout.overrideParentItems` (writes): Overrides parent items on a page (0-based) so they can be edited there; answers the copies' ids.
  - `ids` integer[], object ids; default: the selection
  - `page` integer, 0-based
- `layout.removeOverrides` (writes): Deletes a page's overridden parent copies so the parent items show again.
  - `page` integer, 0-based
- `layout.detachAll` (writes): Detaches a page's overridden copies from the parent, making them ordinary items.
  - `page` integer, 0-based

### Edit > Transparency Blend Space

- `edit.transparencyBlendSpace` (writes): Sets the colour space (CMYK or RGB) transparency is composited in for output.
  - `space` string, one of `cmyk` | `rgb`

### Edit > Find/Change

- `find.find` (reads): Finds text (or a GREP pattern) in the document, a story or the selection and answers every match with its story and byte offsets; changes nothing.
  - `caseSensitive` boolean
  - `find` string
  - `grep` boolean
  - `scope` string, one of `document` | `story` | `selection`
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
  - `wholeWord` boolean
- `find.change` (writes): Replaces every match of text (or a GREP pattern) with new text, in a scope; answers how many changed.
  - `attrs` object
  - `caseSensitive` boolean
  - `change` string
  - `find` string
  - `first` boolean, change only the first match
  - `grep` boolean
  - `scope` string
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
  - `wholeWord` boolean

### Type > Text Variables

- `variables.define` (writes): Defines a text variable (custom, last page number, chapter number, file name, dates, running header…).
  - `after` string
  - `before` string
  - `character` boolean
  - `extension` boolean
  - `format` string
  - `name` string
  - `section` boolean
  - `style` string
  - `text` string
  - `type` string, one of `custom` | `lastPageNumber` | `chapterNumber` | `fileName` | `creationDate` | `modificationDate` | `outputDate` | `runningHeader`
  - `use` string, one of `firstOnPage` | `lastOnPage`
- `variables.insert` (writes): Inserts a text variable at the text insertion point.
  - `name` string

### Type > Hyperlinks & Cross-References

- `xref.insert` (writes): Inserts a cross-reference to a text anchor or paragraph in a format at the insertion point.
  - `format` string, default Full Paragraph & Page Number
- `anchor.create` (writes): Creates a named text anchor (hyperlink destination) at the insertion point.
  - `name` string
- `xref.defineFormat` (writes): Defines a cross-reference format from building blocks such as <paraText /> and <pageNum />.
  - `definition` string
  - `name` string
- `hyperlink.create` (writes): Creates a hyperlink from the selected text or objects to a URL, email or page.
  - `email` string
  - `ids` array
  - `name` string
  - `page` integer, 1-based; one of several alternative parameters
  - `url` string, 1-based; one of several alternative parameters

### Layout > Index

- `index.addReference` (writes): Adds an index page reference for topics (default: the selected text) or a see/see also reference.
  - `paragraphs` integer
  - `range` string, one of `currentPage` | `toEndOfStory` | `suppressPageRange` | `nextParagraphs` | `see` | `seeAlso`
  - `sort` json[], [keys]
  - `target` string
  - `topics` string[], topic levels 1 to 4
- `index.generate` (writes): Generates an index with a title, section headings and run-in option in a new frame.
  - `page` integer, a page counted from 1
  - `rect` number[], [x0, y0, x1, y1]
  - `runIn` boolean, default `false`

- `index.update` (writes): Regenerates the existing index. No parameters.

### Object > Anchored Object

- `anchored.insert` (writes): Anchors objects in a story at a text position, inline or above line, with offsets.
  - `align` string, one of `left` | `center` | `right`
  - `ids` array

  - `pos` integer, a text position
  - `position` string, one of `inline` | `aboveLine` | `custom`
  - `spaceAfter` number
  - `spaceBefore` number
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
  - `xOffset` number, points
  - `yOffset` number, points
- `anchored.options` (writes): Changes an anchored object's position and offsets.
  - `align` string, one of `left` | `center` | `right`
  - `index` integer, a position counted from 0 (the first is 0); default: the object at the insertion point
  - `keepWithinColumn` boolean
  - `position` string, one of `inline` | `aboveLine` | `custom`
  - `spaceAfter` number
  - `spaceBefore` number
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
  - `xOffset` number, points
  - `yOffset` number, points
- `anchored.release` (writes): Releases an anchored object back onto the page.

### View > Grids & Guides

- `guide.deleteAll` (writes): Deletes every guide on a spread.
  - `spread` integer or object

### Window > Links

- `links.relink` (writes): Points every placement of a graphic at another file.
  - `asset` integer
  - `path` file
- `links.relinkFolder` (writes): Relinks graphics to files of the same name in a folder, optionally with another extension.
  - `assets` json[], [ids]
  - `dir` file, folder to look in (default: each link's own folder); default: each link's own folder
  - `extension` string, a file extension such as tif
  - `missingOnly` boolean, default true with `dir`
- `links.update` (writes): Reloads modified links from their files (one or all).
  - `asset` integer
- `links.embed` (writes): Embeds a linked graphic in the document.
  - `asset` integer
- `links.goTo` (writes): Selects the frames showing a linked graphic.
  - `asset` integer

### Edit > Spelling

- `spelling.check` (reads): Checks spelling in a story or the document and answers misspelled words with positions and suggestions.
  - `story` integer, a story id from document.inspect
  - `suggestions` boolean, default `true`
- `spelling.addWord` (writes): Adds a word to the document's user dictionary.
  - `word` boolean

### Edit > Spelling > User Dictionary

- `hyphenation.addException` (writes): Adds a hyphenation exception: breaks only at ~, or never for a word without ~.
  - `word` boolean

### Window > Output > Preflight

- `preflight.run` (reads): Checks the document for output problems (missing fonts and links, low-resolution images, overset text…) and answers the issues.
  - `minPpi` integer, default `150`

## Examples

From [`agent/guide.md`](../agent/guide.md).

### Example 1: a branded band and a centred line of type

```json
layout_run {"path": "Flyer.klayout", "steps": [
  {"command": "swatch.create", "params": {"name": "Brand", "color": {"c": 70, "m": 75, "y": 0, "k": 0}}},
  {"command": "frame.create", "params": {"rect": [72, 300, 540, 420], "content": "unassigned"}},
  {"command": "frame.create", "params": {"rect": [72, 450, 540, 520], "content": "text", "text": "Saturday 8 pm, Town Hall"}}
]}
```

Answer: `completed: [{result: {name: "Brand"}}, {result: {id: 9}}, {result: {id: 10, story: 11}}]`.
Use those ids:

```json
layout_run {"path": "Flyer.klayout", "steps": [
  {"command": "object.fill", "params": {"swatch": "Brand", "ids": [9]}},
  {"command": "text.select", "params": {"story": 11, "anchor": 0, "focus": 24}},
  {"command": "type.char", "params": {"attrs": {"size": 28, "fill": "Brand"}}},
  {"command": "object.align", "params": {"edge": "hcenter", "to": "page", "ids": [10]}}
]}
layout_check {"path": "Flyer.klayout"}
→ {"diagnostics": []}
```

### Example 2: fixing what the check finds

```json
layout_check {"path": "Programme.klayout"}
→ {"diagnostics": [{"code": "layout.overset", "severity": "error", "target": {"page": 1, "path": "item:10"},
    "message": "Overset text: 1123 characters.", "fix": {"command": "frame.fitText", "params": {"ids": [10]}}}]}
```

Over a thousand characters do not fit, so the fix would shrink the type to a couple of points
(`frame.fitText` answers `{stories: [{size: 2.0}]}`). Make room instead, then check again:

```json
layout_run {"path": "Programme.klayout", "steps": [
  {"command": "transform.resize", "params": {"ids": [10], "from": [72, 300, 200, 320], "to": [72, 300, 540, 720]}}
]}
layout_check {"path": "Programme.klayout"}
```

A missing font is replaced as the fix says:

```json
layout_check {"path": "Poster.klayout"}
→ {"diagnostics": [{"code": "layout.missing-font", "severity": "error", "message": "Missing font: Kition Missing Sans.",
    "fix": {"command": "font.replace", "params": {"family": "Kition Missing Sans", "toFamily": "Source Serif 4"}}}]}
layout_run {"path": "Poster.klayout", "steps": [
  {"command": "font.replace", "params": {"family": "Kition Missing Sans", "toFamily": "Source Serif 4"}}
]}
layout_check {"path": "Poster.klayout"}
→ {"diagnostics": []}
```
